name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape. Changelog (last 3): 7.264.0 — The prototype's contracted mark records what the rounds left behind: --mark opened stores the base commit, --mark contracted stamps the brief's Prototype: line (the design prose below it is historical, contract.json is current) and writes a reconcile block into contract.json listing every docs/adr and docs/roadmap file committed since opening plus every stray file in the prototype folder; the CONTRACTED step prints both lists and names the stamped brief to commit, and /spec:plan's contract entry turns each listed ADR into a Decisions row (the pin that outranks it, or superseded). The picture command's {url}/{out}/{width}/{height} placeholders are substituted as quoted variable references (PROTO_PICTURE_*), so a state url carrying & reaches the host command whole instead of backgrounding it. The comment-sweep certificate test now judges the sweep commit against its parent instead of the working tree against main, which went red on every later script change. 7.263.0 — Script comments drop their inline changelog: every whole-line comment under spec/scripts and spec/bin loses its spec-path, AC and decision-id citations while keeping its reason, each file keeps at most one Owner: header line, and the code is certified unchanged; the doctrine line-budget, heading-list and sentence-pin tests retire (specs/20261024/04). 7.262.0 — Genesis now trusts its recorded facts instead of stand-ins: the MENUS gate and menus-done read the menu-written records (a hand-written menu file no longer advances the run, and menus-done names every open dimension with no record), and the design-brief and design-approval states derive from their marks alone, since the mark handlers already verify the artifacts.
